cartInvalid: Cart data is invalid. Please refresh and try again.
offlineRecorded: No connection — the sale is recorded offline and will sync automatically (duplicates are impossible).
saleFailed: The sale could not be completed.
chargesDescription: Named extras added to the final total after VAT (e.g. delivery, service). They are never discounted.
cartEmptyHint: Scan a barcode or click products to start a sale.
belowOnePackage: That is less than 1 {{unit}} — line left unchanged.
overrideDescription: Charges this line at your price — the product's selling price is not changed. The server re-checks your permission and the minimum price floors.
managerApprovalRequired: A sale below the minimum needs a manager with below-minimum approval.
belowMinimumReasonPlaceholder: Reason for selling below the minimum (required)
